theorems.name: Submission.cbr_cidc_dilation_integral_rep
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ m * X ω') → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μ) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, X' ω = ∫ y, ξ (a + lam • y) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
